subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Which remaining #87711 subproblem should be canonical for the next repair: reset transcript-store atomicity/self-heal, Telegram visible fallback or heartbeat, or usage finalization and reset help text?
rationale: The source still supports a real reset/session invariant bug, but the issue also asks for new channel UX and schema behavior that automation should not choose as one combined product direction.

options.title: Fix reset binding first
options.body: Treat the reset transcript/store invariant as the canonical repair and track heartbeat, usage schema, and help copy separately.

options.title: Make Telegram recovery primary
options.body: Prioritize a user-visible Telegram fallback or heartbeat even if the lower-level reset atomicity fix remains separate.

options.title: Keep as umbrella only
options.body: Leave this item open as a maintainer umbrella and require narrower child issues before any repair PR starts.

recommendation.title: Fix reset binding first
recommendation.body: Treat the reset transcript/store invariant as the canonical repair and track heartbeat, usage schema, and help copy separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is recent work on gateway session reset and session creation paths, which matches the recommended first repair boundary.
